outcome.backend: The historical backend run used Ridu's former ordinary PostgreSQL pool default of 20 and Payload's default of 10. Ridu completed the selected-field API workloads with materially higher throughput, lower tail latency, and lower application RSS, but the 4.765x multiplier is not a current equal-pool result.
outcome.relationships: A final same-concurrency strict slice validated exact populated author/category IDs and required the expected collaborator/related-post targets on 5,000 responses per framework; Ridu led throughput 3.706x with 75.01% lower p95.
outcome.releaseReadiness: The original Ridu admin failure was an invalid benchmark setup that served the generic fallback bundle. A corrected application-specific production admin passed login, dashboard, 10,002-row list, full editor, French, and Arabic RTL checks with no browser warnings or errors.
outcome.currentPoolStatus: Ridu's ordinary PostgreSQL pool now defaults to 10 to match Payload; the separate four-connection upload-lock pool is unchanged. The full backend stress suite has not yet been rerun at 10 versus 10.
outcome.payloadWriteBoundary: A same-harness, same-standalone A/B at concurrency 16 produced 32/32 timeouts with Payload's default pool of 10 and 2,317/2,317 successes when the only recorded benchmark tuning change was PAYLOAD_POOL_MAX=20. The default server did not recover within the configured ten-second window.

evidenceClasses.primaryLongRuns: Hashed raw results with complete per-request/resource data, but the then-untracked generating harness was not self-hashed and was subsequently hardened.
evidenceClasses.finalStrictRuns: Hashed raw results that include the exact historical backend harness SHA-256, effective configuration, allowlisted inherited benchmark tuning variables, strict field/relationship validation, and a clean immutable Payload tree hash.
evidenceClasses.correctedAdminRun: Hashed setup raw recording the current harness, new 10-connection-default Ridu binary, application-specific admin tree, fresh 10,000-post dataset, and successful health/count reconciliation. Browser observations remain operator-recorded without a retained trace.
evidenceClasses.operatorObservations: Browser and hey timings recorded in the report without retained trace or console-output artifacts; qualitative corroboration only.

payloadPoolSameArtifactAB.interpretation: Changing the only recorded benchmark tuning variable, the pool maximum, moved the fixture from total timeout and no recovery within the configured ten-second window to complete success at concurrency 16. This strongly implicates pool capacity, but other inherited process environment was not serialized and the pre-launch source migration/config files were not hashed in these raws, so this is not a completely sealed causal experiment. It does not explain the internal reason so many transactions are held.

caveats: One local machine, one primary long run per framework, and one three-trial short control do not establish universal performance or confidence intervals.
The fixtures are behaviorally comparable but not identical. Payload initializes an additional localized global and capability collection; Ridu runs a lightweight preview listener.
Selected fields and observable operations match, but response envelopes differ. Ridu's primary selected list and point responses were larger than Payload's.
The primary soak does not populate relationships; the final strict slice covers population but all generated rows share the same relationship targets.
Published backend tables used Ridu 20 versus Payload 10. Ridu now defaults to 10, but a full 10-versus-10 backend rerun has not been performed.
Application RSS is summed process-tree RSS; the shared PostgreSQL server is excluded.
The PostgreSQL waiting counter means any non-null wait_event, including idle ClientRead, and must not be read as lock waiting.
CPU comes from macOS ps samples; derived CPU time per request is approximate.
Ridu dataset seeding performs create and publish as two requests, while Payload creates each published document in one request.
The benchmark repaired stale Payload fixture migration files in the worktree; the task did not commit them.

Browser and hey timings have no retained trace/output artifact and are not inputs to the hashed backend tables. Corrected Ridu admin timings were not measured during a five-minute soak and are not directly comparable with Payload's during-soak timings.
Aborted pilot runs, including a quadratic result-aggregation implementation, are excluded.
